retention.reason: Root's cleanup inspection identified the request chat as historical payment evidence linked by requestId/idempotency_key; the two associated messages are retained, not treated as disposable fixtures.

limitations: Do not replace the original commit and timestamps of historical session/admin or SQL evidence with the new payment commit.
Observed net debit does not exclude concurrent compensating chain activity; database and Horizon reads are not an atomic cross-system snapshot.
A confirmed payment can retain delivery pending if the provider body was lost before persistence; chain evidence cannot reconstruct that body.
No real timeout, restart during sending or provider failure was induced; those cases remain supported by local and synthetic SQL tests.
Chat/memory historical evidence remains separate. Bazaar, other networks and Mainnet are outside this acceptance.
